summary: Practise communication, goal-setting and self-management with workplace scenarios and practical tools. Explore the life skills course.
lede: Workplace life skills practice helps professionals handle communication, priorities and interpersonal pressure with practical, repeatable approaches. Designed for professionals, team leaders and people-development staff, it covers identifying triggers and examining reactions through structured CBT reflection, setting SMART goals and priorities, and using active listening and Nonviolent Communication to respond to workplace conflict; scenarios and action planning connect these skills to everyday work.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who need repeatable ways to handle everyday communication, priorities and interpersonal pressure in their work. Life skills training is designed for professionals applying these behaviours themselves and for those supporting colleagues’ development.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge expected: familiarity with everyday workplace responsibilities and communication. No specialist clinical or counselling background is needed for the practical, non-clinical exercises.
